   234	///|
   235	async fn bulk_one(mode : String, state : Json, options : BulkOptions) -> Json? {
   236	  let id = required(state, "workspaceId")
   237	  let saved_secrets = saved_workspace_secrets(state)
   238	  let secrets = saved_secrets.unwrap_or([])
   239	  if saved_secrets is None {
   240	    suppress_workspace_recording(state)
   241	  }
   242	  let result : Json = {
   243	    "id": id,
   244	    "uid": required(state, "workspaceUid"),
   245	    "context": required(state, "context"),
   246	    "provider": options.provider,
   247	    "identityVerified": false,
   248	    "vmStatus": "unknown",
   249	    "activity": "unknown",
   250	    "outcome": "skipped",
   251	  }
   252	  let mut mutating = false
   253	  try {
   254	    set_field(result, "autoStop", idle_status(state))
   255	    let effective_context = bulk_context(state)
   256	    guard required(state, "context") == effective_context else {
   257	      save_diagnostic(
   258	        "bulk-workspace",
   259	        "excluded",
   260	        evidence={
   261	          "id": id,
   262	          "savedContext": required(state, "context"),
   263	          "effectiveContext": effective_context,
   264	          "reason": "context_mismatch",
   265	        },
   266	        protected_secrets=secrets,
   267	        environment=workspace_environment(state),
   268	        recording=operation_recording(state),
   269	      )
   270	      return None
   271	    }
   272	    let lock = connection_operation_lock(state)
   273	    defer lock.close()
   274	    snapshot_workspace_recording(state, required(state, "tunnelDirectory"))
   275	    match saved_workspace_secrets(state) {
   276	      Some(values) =>
   277	        for secret in values {
   278	          secrets.push(secret)
   279	        }
   280	      None => suppress_workspace_recording(state)
   281	    }
   282	    let (in_scope, matched) = bulk_identity(state, options.provider)
   283	    guard in_scope else { return None }
   284	    set_field(result, "identityVerified", Json::boolean(matched))
   285	    guard matched else {
   286	      set_field(
   287	        result,
   288	        "evidence",
   289	        unknown_activity("workspace_missing_or_replaced"),
   290	      )
   291	      save_diagnostic(
   292	        "bulk-workspace",
   293	        "skipped",
   294	        error_type="workspace_missing_or_replaced",
   295	        evidence=result,
   296	        protected_secrets=secrets,
   297	        environment=workspace_environment(state),
   298	        recording=operation_recording(state),
   299	      )
   300	      return Some(result)
   301	    }
   302	    let status = workspace_status(state)
   303	    set_field(result, "vmStatus", Json::string(status))
   304	    let evidence = if status != "Running" {
   305	      unknown_activity("workspace_not_running")
   306	    } else if options.force || mode == "resume" {
   307	      unknown_activity(
   308	        if options.force {
   309	          "forced_without_activity_check"
   310	        } else {
   311	          "resume_does_not_require_activity"
   312	        },
   313	      )
   314	    } else {
   315	      observe_activity(state) catch {
   316	        error =>
   317	          unknown_activity(
   318	            diagnostic_error(error, environment=workspace_environment(state)),
   319	          )
   320	      }
   321	    }
   322	    set_field(result, "activity", field(evidence, "activity").unwrap())
   323	    set_field(result, "evidence", evidence)
   324	    save_diagnostic(
   325	      "bulk-observation",
   326	      mode,
   327	      tunnel_directory=required(state, "tunnelDirectory"),
   328	      evidence=result,
   329	      protected_secrets=secrets,
   330	      environment=workspace_environment(state),
   331	      recording=operation_recording(state),
   332	    )
   333	    if mode == "status" {
   334	      set_field(result, "outcome", Json::string("observed"))
   335	      save_diagnostic(
   336	        "bulk-workspace",
   337	        "observed",
   338	        evidence=result,
   339	        protected_secrets=secrets,
   340	        environment=workspace_environment(state),
   341	        recording=operation_recording(state),
   342	      )
   343	      return Some(result)
   344	    }
   345	    if mode == "stop" {
   346	      if status == "Stopped" {
   347	        set_field(result, "reason", Json::string("already_stopped"))
   348	      } else if !options.force &&
   349	        (
   350	          status != "Running" ||
   351	          field(evidence, "activity") != Some(Json::string("idle"))
   352	        ) {
   353	        set_field(result, "reason", Json::string("not_idle"))
   354	      } else {
   355	        let (scope, valid) = bulk_identity(state, options.provider)
   356	        guard scope && valid else {
   357	          raise AdapterError("Workspace changed before stop")
   358	        }
   359	        mutating = true
   360	        pause_tunnel(state)
   361	        defer unpause_tunnel(state)
   362	        stop_workspace(state)
   363	        set_field(result, "outcome", Json::string("success"))
   364	      }
   365	    } else if status == "Running" {
   366	      set_field(result, "reason", Json::string("already_running"))
   367	    } else if status != "Stopped" {
   368	      set_field(result, "reason", Json::string("workspace_not_stopped"))
   369	    } else {
   370	      let (scope, valid) = bulk_identity(state, options.provider)
   371	      guard scope && valid else {
   372	        raise AdapterError("Workspace changed before resume")
   373	      }
   374	      mutating = true
   375	      unpause_tunnel(state)
   376	      ignore(
   377	        devsy(
   378	          state,
   379	          [
   380	            "--result-format", "json", "workspace", "up", "--id", id, "--ide-launch",
   381	            "skip",
   382	          ] +
   383	          orca_storage_args(state),
   384	          "workspace-resume",
   385	        ),
   386	      )
   387	      set_field(result, "outcome", Json::string("success"))
   388	      idle_reset(state, "workspace_resumed")
   389	    }
   390	  } catch {
   391	    error => {
   392	      set_field(
   393	        result,
   394	        "outcome",
   395	        Json::string(if mutating { "failed" } else { "skipped" }),
   396	      )
   397	      let detail = diagnostic_error(
   398	        error,
   399	        environment=workspace_environment(state),
   400	      )
   401	      set_field(result, "evidence", unknown_activity(detail))
   402	      set_field(result, "error", Json::string(detail))
   403	    }
   404	  }
   405	  if mode == "resume" &&
   406	    field(result, "outcome") == Some(Json::string("success")) {
   407	    recover_connection(state) catch {
   408	      error => {
   409	        set_field(result, "outcome", Json::string("failed"))
   410	        set_field(
   411	          result,
   412	          "error",
   413	          Json::string(
   414	            diagnostic_error(error, environment=workspace_environment(state)),
   415	          ),
   416	        )
   417	      }
   418	    }
   419	  }
   420	  save_diagnostic(
   421	    "bulk-workspace",
   422	    mode,
   423	    evidence=result,
   424	    protected_secrets=secrets,
